label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Some good news to start with: on Monday 16 November, Priya Bhatia joins the practice. Priya is a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) and has spent the last nine years at a consultancy in Coventry. I'm genuinely delighted she's chosen to come and work with us.

I also owe a lot of you an honest word about the last couple of months. In September and October, beam calculations and drawings were taking five to six weeks to come back. That's far too long, and several of you told me so. One of you left a review saying so, and I can't argue with it. A couple in Harborne had their builder standing waiting with the steel already ordered. We turned their job round in three days in the end, but only after they'd had to chase us twice. They shouldn't have needed to.

That was my fault. I said yes to more work than one person can do properly. By October I was doing site visits during the day and calculations until midnight, and my wife had started calling the office "the other house". She had a point.

With Priya on board, our target for beam calcs and drawings is now 10 working days. If you're waiting on us at the moment, your job is moving. Please message me directly if you'd like to know exactly where it's up to.

One other change. From 1 January 2027, first site visits will cost £95. If you go ahead with the work, that £95 comes off your fee, so you're only paying it if the job goes no further. I've enjoyed offering free visits, but about a third of them never turned into a job, and that time has to come from somewhere. Often it came from the people already waiting on us. If your visit is already booked when this post goes up, it stays free, whatever date it's on.

Over the coming weeks Priya will be out on site with me. If you see her, do say hello and give her a proper Birmingham welcome. Thank you to everyone who's stuck with us through a slow patch. Things really are getting better from here.
